name: Time4VPS

evidence.vps: 03: self-managed Linux, Windows and container VPS; the customer installs services and updates the OS

line: Rent a Linux or Windows VPS and manage the server yourself.

work.math: €2.99 a month, but the 3-month minimum is €8.97 prepaid. Linux 1 has 1 CPU unit, 1 GB, 10 GB and 1 TB of listed transfer. Transfer direction and request performance are unverified. VAT is not included.
